report.notes: R5-01 root cause addressed per diagnosis: evaluate._NUMBER now captures the full numeral run (digits joined by , . or a space/NBSP/thin/narrow-NBSP before a 3-digit group) plus sign (-, U+2212, 'minus'); _read() accepts only western, Indian lakh/crore, space-grouped or plain forms, keeps multi-dot literals (dates/versions) exactly, splits space-joined runs that are not valid grouping (e.g. '2020 100'), and otherwise returns an UNREADABLE sentinel ('?'+span), never fragments. synthesize.verify drops any claim with an unreadable numeral (NUMBER_NOT_IN_CITED_SOURCE); find_conflicts skips subset suppression when either side is unreadable. Verified: 62 of 80 new web cases fail at 52e852d, all 80 pass after; the 18 that pass both ways are guards. tests/web 284 passed. Not done: numeric equality of 1,000.5 vs 1,000.50 (diagnosis extra), because the existing R1-01 test expects numbers('Rs.1,250.50') == {'1250.50'}; such a claim is dropped (fail-closed). R5-02: api_key rule extended in both layers (Stripe sk_/rk_/pk_ live|test, github_pat_, glpat-, npm_, hf_, SG.), new basic_auth text rule (needs a digit or + / = in a token of 12+ characters), field stems authoriz/twostep, whole-word tan/mtan/smstan/otc/2sv and 'two step'; redact.py docstring updated. 19 of 31 new assist tests fail at 52e852d, all 31 pass after, including the real-Chromium in-page test and the Brain-request test; tests/assist 2087 passed. docs/assist/A0_QUALIFICATION.md L-A0-2 left unchanged (redaction is still rule-based). graphify update not run: graphify command not installed in this environment.
